reply.text:
Wanting to push harder is a fair goal, and there's a smart way to do it. The biggest lever is progressive overload: add a little weight or a rep to a lift each week, and keep most sets with one or two reps still in the tank. That builds strength faster than grinding every set to failure, and you recover well enough to keep progressing.

If you want, I can look at your recent lifts and tell you where you have room to move up. Or tell me what you want to push, strength, muscle or conditioning, and I'll set up something to match.
